decision: Selected the centroid of the union of ALKIS parcels Alteno Flur 1 Flurstück 44/1 and Flurstück 192 (the two parcels on which the Stadt Luckau places the Geltungsbereich of Bebauungsplan Nr. 04.1.02 for the data-centre building field) as the project locator; the data-centre buildings are not separately located.
identity_bridge: Stadt Luckau Beschlussvorlage V Stvv/26/029 (21 July 2026; decided at the Stadtverordnetenversammlung of 27 August 2026): a hyperscale data centre is to be built in the area of the in-force Bebauungspläne Nr. 01 and 01a 'Industriegebiet Alteno'; B-Plan Nr. 04.1.02 covers Flurstück 44/1 and the planting strip on Flurstück 192 (Flur 1, Gemarkung Alteno), about 2 ha, to create one contiguous building field.
Anlage 2 to V Stvv/26/029 (plan-area sheet, 1 July 2026) labels parcels 191, 201, 44/1, 192, 136, 160, 209, 43/1 and 253 around the Geltungsbereich.

DiPlanung Brandenburg procedure of the 14th FNP amendment (Stadt Luckau) carries a drawn change-area polygon of about 17110 m2 that covers 15114 m2 of Flurstück 44/1 (about 98 percent of the parcel) and 488 m2 of Flurstück 192; its centroid lies 116 m east of the selected point.

consistency_checks.alkis_buildings_on_selected_parcels: none (ave:GebaeudeBauwerk bbox query 416700-417700 E, 5746900-5747600 N returned 10 objects, all west or south-west of the selected parcels, around Frederik-Ipsen-Straße 1 and 5)
consistency_checks.other_parcels_numbered_44_or_192_in_gema: Flur 1 Flurstück 44/3; Flur 2 Flurstücke 44 and 192; Flur 3 Flurstück 44 - excluded because the Vorlage names Flur 1, 44/1 and 192

transform_check: Parcel polygons (EPSG:25833, Brandenburg ALKIS vereinfacht WFS) unioned and centroid computed with shapely 2.1.1, transformed to WGS84 with pyproj 3.7.1 (PROJ 9.5.1), always_xy.

excluded_coordinates.reason: Procedure marker for the FNP change area only, not the building field.
Administrative centre, about 6 km west; not the site.
